. The learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that without notice, on 21.09.2024 at 12.00 p.m, a portion of the compound wall of the petitioner's property which is a petrol bunk has been demolished.

It is made clear that from the survey of the land, if it is found that the compound wall which has been demolished comes within the property of a petitioner, then the respondents shall repair and construct the demolished / damaged portion at their cost.
The respondents have also assured the Court that no activity would be undertaken till the survey is conducted.
4. Recording the above, this Writ Petition stands disposed of.
No costs.
Consequently, connected Miscellaneous Petition is closed.
